Weekly payouts

Once a week: see what came in, what this batch pays out and what stays, then press Pay this week — one approval in the Treasury wallet. Every transaction is checked before you sign it, the store re-checks every payment on-chain afterwards, and a half-finished batch continues where it stopped. No key ever leaves your wallet. The admin key stays in this tab only.
